title: Flimsy Handle
text: Flimsy Handle. Kind of flimsy plastic handle. It would work on soft things, but scraping natural peanut butter out of a jar is a challenge.

product_metadata.title: Norpro Silicone Jar/Icing Spatula, Blue, 10.5in/26.5cm, As Shown
features: Beautifully ice your cakes, cupcakes and more with this quality icing spatula.
The thin and flexible edges are perfect for reaching into deep jars and scraping the edges of bowls.
Also ideal for removing baked goods from dishes without breaking or crumbling.
Silicone won't stain, lose shape or retain odor.
Silicone head is high heat resistant to 400F/205C.
The handle is made of a beautifully colored clear/blue tone Acrylic.
Fits perfectly in any kitchen drawer.
